content.text:
I rewrote 0.html, keeping the same content (a single centered circle) while fixing layout and accessibility issues.

Changes:
- **Removed the horizontal scrollbar.** The old `width: 100vw` plus default scrollbar width overflowed the page. The body now fills the viewport with `min-height: 100dvh`, which also handles mobile browser chrome correctly.
- **Made the circle responsive.** It stays at 400px on desktop but shrinks on small screens so it never gets clipped.
- **Added accessibility.** The SVG has a `role="img"` and a `<title>` so screen readers announce it instead of skipping it.
- **Added a readable page title** in place of the random hash.
- **Added light and dark color schemes.** The circle uses `currentColor`, so it flips automatically with the user's system theme.
- **Added `box-sizing: border-box`** and a system font stack as sane defaults for any future additions.
